entries.title: A task split into parts lists its parts and says what they wait on
entries.body: The record of a task split into parts now lists each part with its status in a list you can fold away, and pressing a part opens it. Its top sentence says what its parts wait on, such as its last part waiting for your Start, instead of a Start the task itself never takes. A wait with no time to show no longer says "time unknown", on every task.

picture.alt: A task's record showing its sentence about its last part, and its parts list with one open part and four closed ones.
